text.ko: 업종 내 약한 편. 강점: 잉여현금흐름 마진 35.8%. 약점: 자기자본이익률(ROE) 1.1%.
text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Free cash flow margin 35.8%. Weakness: Return on equity 1.1%.

text.en: Strong within its sector. Strength: Revenue growth consistency 100%. Weakness: 3-yr EPS growth (annual) -14.5%.

text.ko: 업종 평균 수준. 강점: 차입금의존도 0.0%. 약점: 매출채권 회수기간 115일.
text.en: About average for its sector. Strength: Borrowings to assets 0.0%. Weakness: Days sales outstanding 115 days.

text.ko: 업종 내 매우 약함. 약점: PEG(성장 대비 PER) 적자/음수 · n/m.
text.en: Very weak within its sector. Weakness: PEG ratio n/m (negative).

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경이 이 업종에 불리한 편이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (불리). 부채가 적어 금리 영향은 덜해요.
text.en: The current economy tends to work against this sector. Main factor: rising rates (hurts). Low debt cushions rate effects.
